::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/hubspot/app/subscriptions"}
#docs
Authenticated by HubSpot's request signature (v3 for cards, v2 for workflow actions); an org key is not accepted. Refused with 403 unless the business allows creating subscriptions from HubSpot.

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-HubSpot-Signature-v3` | `string` | no | HubSpot's request signature. |
| `X-HubSpot-Request-Timestamp` | `string` | no | When HubSpot sent the request, in unix milliseconds. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | OK |
| `401` | Missing or invalid HubSpot signature |
| `409` | The portal is connected to several businesses and the record is linked to none of them |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/hubspot/app/subscriptions" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{}
```
```json [401 Unauthorized]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "authentication_error",
    "message": "Missing or invalid HubSpot signature"
  }
}
```
```json [409 Conflict]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "conflict_error",
    "message": "The portal is connected to several businesses and the record is linked to none of them"
  }
}
```
